branches.required: B_ab complete sum; per-coordinate standard_exponent_admissible; support [-1668,5248]^4

definitions.B_ab: [R(K_cov Pi + A h S Pi)F]_ab; complete standard branch sum
definitions.Delta_ab: product of each positive owned factor f in D_ab once; distinct owners are not merged
definitions.N_ab: C_a C_b Z_ab B_ab + Z_ab sum_u Qhat_u P_[u,a,b] - C_a Z_ab sum_(u,v) Qhat_u Qhat_v P_[u,v,b]
definitions.Qhat_v: Qcarrier_v(local) * product_pair Qline_vi(local) * product_complement L_vi(local) * product_(e_vi=1) x_i^(-14*d_v-deg(ell_vi)*[i in pair])
definitions.common_alternation: general common cochains vanish only on repeated (carrier,legal_mask,standard_tag); full five-field denominator owners never merge
definitions.derivative: partial_i T(F)_ab=(Delta_ab partial_i N_ab - N_ab sum_f a_f(partial_i f) Delta_ab/f)/(D_ab Delta_ab)
definitions.source_identity: P_[r,s,t] = C_r C_s C_t (s*F)_[r,s,t]; source-first sign; repeated (carrier,legal_mask) zero even across standard tags

recipe.output_edge: increasing source-first common edge; extend the complete result alternatingly to reversed edges; repeated common edge zero
